scope: F07 slide removal reverse references; F09 memberships and F46 links/actions; preservation of shared notes/resources

mapping_decisions.J01: removeSlides is a byte-operation API; model target_slide/click_action spellings are unchanged planned obligations. No model aliases.
mapping_decisions.J02: Deletion selectors are immutable source-fingerprint locations. Surviving part/slide IDs remain stable; no live handle claim.
mapping_decisions.J03: Input position explicitly one/zero-based; CLI is one-based. Relative navigation resolves against original slide-list positions. Out-of-bounds and history-dependent navigation reject.
mapping_decisions.J06: removeSlides always returns Promise<Uint8Array>; bytes, streams and VFS require explicit context; no implicit I/O.
mapping_decisions.J07: No execution of preserved action strings, network or ambient time.
mapping_decisions.J08: dangling-reference is OfficeError at validate-intent, command exit 1, affected 0 on rejection. Missing selector flags are usage exit 2; missing/stale resolved selections exit 1.
mapping_decisions.J09: Namespace-aware bounded parser/splice operations; opaque extension/reference refusal. Unknown ignored markup is not proof of unreferenced content.
mapping_decisions.J10: slides.remove matches CLI slides remove, --reference-policy remove maps to referencePolicy. No arbitrary model invocation.

documentation_drift: Format section 6.4 describes implicit section/show membership removal; current user explicitly requires repair/remove policy. Added optional referencePolicy=remove; absence rejects affected memberships instead of silently repairing.
Historical audit not-started statuses describe the live model and original audit task. This receipt records the implemented byte operation without falsely upgrading whole-model coverage.
No slide deletion method exists in the pinned public Slides collection; deletion is an additive format operation, not a renamed documented model method.

Whole-public-API and full upstream suite parity remain incomplete. Prior slide-order-case-accounting.json records the related 26 unit, 8 BDD and 93 API identity/collection cases; retain that accounting and its open obligations.

original_cases.domain: 36 original memfs cases; first/last/nonconsecutive/all selection, custom shows/sections empty-container cleanup, named/relative actions, opaque namespaces/extensions/action refusal, owned notes and shared media/theme retention.
original_cases.command: 14 original memfs cases, compiled schemas, output/error semantics and selectors.
original_cases.shell: Existing registered create.test.ts adds SDK-byte parity, independent retained IDs, dry-run/in-place/binary pipeline.
